title: 怎样约定邮件、聊天和会议分别用来做什么
topic: 怎样约定邮件、聊天和会议分别用来做什么

source.title: Make a team agreement on collaboration tools - Dropbox
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录

paragraphs: Before the virtual workshop, ask your team to jot down the tools they regularly use for collaboration, writing and designing, documentation, knowledge management, project management, whiteboarding, and more. Ask them to reflect: How are these tools working for us?
After you’ve kicked off your meeting, pull up tooling 101 (below) on your screen. Review it with your team and then discuss: Does this make sense? Did anything surprise or confuse you?

Once you know what healthy tooling looks like, you can give your habits a score. Fill out the tool use scorecard (below) with your team. When you’re done, reflect: How healthy are our tool habits? What’s the one thing we most need to change?

Now that you understand your team’s tool tendencies, you can begin to build habits that minimize disruption and increase focus. Use the tool rules worksheet below to get started. When you’re done, discuss: Can we all agree to this? Are there any downsides or risks to these rules? (For example: If your IT team doesn’t support a tool you love, will it present a security risk to users?)

Once you’ve drafted your tool rules, put them somewhere that’s easy-to-find, central, and public. If there are any risks in your choice of tools, decide what you’ll do to mitigate them, and who’s responsible. Schedule an asynchronous check-in for 1–2 months later to see how your agreements are going. Then sit back and enjoy the sound of a ping-free afternoon. More resources
translations: 在虚拟研讨会之前，请要求您的团队成员记下他们经常使用的协作工具、写作和设计工具、文档工具、知识管理工具、项目管理工具、白板工具等等。请他们反思：这些工具对我们来说效果如何？
在您启动会议后，在屏幕上展示工具入门知识（如下）。与您的团队一起回顾它，然后讨论：这合理吗？有什么让您惊讶或困惑的地方吗？
一旦您了解了健康工具使用的情况，您就可以给您的习惯打分。与您的团队一起填写工具使用评分卡（如下）。完成后，反思：我们的工具习惯有多健康？我们最需要改变的一件事是什么？
既然您了解了团队的工具使用倾向，您就可以开始建立减少干扰、提高专注度的习惯。使用下面的工具规则工作表开始。完成后，讨论：我们都能同意这些规则吗？这些规则有什么缺点或风险？（例如：如果您的IT团队不支持您喜欢的工具，它会给用户带来安全风险吗？）
一旦您起草了工具规则，请将它们放在易于查找、中心化和公开的地方。如果您选择的工具有任何风险，请决定您将采取什么措施来减轻这些风险，以及谁负责。安排1-2个月后的异步跟进会议，看看您的协议执行情况如何。然后坐下来享受一个没有提示音的宁静下午。更多资源

notes.phrase: How are these tools working for us?
notes.meaning: 这些工具是否真正适合团队协作？
notes.explain: working for us 在这里询问现有工具是否满足团队需要。
notes.example: How are these tools working for us across the team?

notes.explain: 在讨论工具习惯前，先回顾当前的使用情况。
notes.example: Take a moment to reflect on how the team shares project updates.

notes.explain: 工具规则需要明确负责人，后续才有人落实。

scenario.title: The same decision appears in three places
english: The product team discusses a launch date in chat, revisits it by email, and then books a meeting because nobody knows which decision is final.
Nora suggests a simple rule: use chat for quick questions, a shared document for decisions, and a meeting only when the team needs live debate.
She puts the rule in the team workspace, names who will maintain it, and schedules a check-in next month to see whether it works.
chinese: 产品团队先在聊天工具里讨论上线日期，又在邮件中重复讨论，最后因没人知道最终决定而安排会议。
Nora 提议明确规则：快速提问用聊天，决定写进共享文档，需要实时讨论时才开会。
她把规则放在团队工作区，指定维护人，并约定下个月检查规则是否有效。

firstAttempt.prompt: 团队在聊天、邮件和会议里重复讨论上线日期。请写两句英文，提议分别用什么渠道做什么，并说明最终决定记在哪里。
firstAttempt.sample: Let’s use chat for quick questions and the shared document for final decisions. We can meet when a topic needs live discussion.
firstAttempt.rationale: 给每个工具分配用途，并指出决定的唯一记录位置。

words.example: We use a shared document for project collaboration.
words.translation: 我们用共享文档进行项目协作。

words.meaning: 任务或工具间的频繁切换
words.example: One decision log can reduce context-switching.
words.translation: 一份决策记录可以减少来回切换。
words.note: 复合名词，常用于说明效率损失。

words.example: Constant notifications can fragment our attention.
words.translation: 持续通知会分散注意力。
words.note: 原文说的是注意力被打散。

words.example: We need clear norms for urgent messages.
words.translation: 我们需要明确紧急消息的团队规则。
words.note: 多用复数，指约定俗成或共同制定的规则。

words.example: A backup owner can mitigate the handoff risk.
words.translation: 备份负责人可以降低交接风险。

words.example: We can collect feedback in an asynchronous check-in.
words.translation: 我们可以在异步回顾中收集反馈。

structure.original: If there are any risks in your choice of tools, decide what you’ll do to mitigate them, and who’s responsible.
analysis: If there are any risks ...：先提出需要处理的条件。
decide what you’ll do ...：明确风险应对动作。
and who’s responsible：补上执行人，避免只写原则。
structure.transfer: If urgent requests might be missed in email, decide which chat channel to use and who will monitor it.

rewrite.bad: Please stop using so many tools. It is confusing.
rewrite.good: Let’s use chat for quick questions and record final decisions in the shared document. We can review this rule next month.
rewrite.translation: 快速问题用聊天工具，最终决定记在共享文档里。我们下个月回顾这条规则。
rewrite.pattern: Let’s use [channel] for [purpose] and record [decision] in [place].

cloze.why: 简单、及时的问题适合用聊天沟通。
重要决定要写在团队可查找的共享文档中。

cloze.prompt: Set up a meeting when the issue needs live ___.
cloze.why: 需要多人实时讨论时再安排会议。

dictation.text: Use this workshop to help your core team agree on which tools you’ll use and how you’ll use them.
dictation.why: 听清 agree on 后面并列的 which 和 how。

dictation.text: Let’s use chat for quick questions and record final decisions in the shared document.
dictation.why: 注意两个工具及其各自用途。

translationPractice.prompt: 当天需要答复的简单问题用聊天沟通。
translationPractice.answer: Use chat for quick questions that need a same-day answer.
translationPractice.why: 即时聊天用于简单、及时的问题

translationPractice.prompt: 把决定写进共享文档，方便整个团队查找。
translationPractice.answer: Put decisions in the shared document so the whole team can find them.
translationPractice.why: 把重要决定留在可查找的地方

translationPractice.prompt: 问题需要实时讨论时，再安排会议。
translationPractice.answer: Set up a meeting when the issue needs a live discussion.

choice.prompt: 团队总在不同工具中重复讨论，哪条规则最可执行？
options: Please communicate better in the future.
Use chat for quick questions, record decisions in the shared document, and review the rule next month.
No one should send messages anymore.
choice.why: 它明确渠道、记录位置和复查时间。

output.prompt: 新成员入组时，常不知道项目决定、日常更新和文件分别在哪里。请用英文建议把团队常用工具和用途整理成一份共享指南。
output.sample: Could we create a short guide to the tools we use and what each one is for? Let’s show where decisions, routine updates, and working documents belong so new teammates can find them.
check: 是否建议盘点工具并说明用途？
是否举出信息存放的具体类别？
是否说明指南如何帮助新成员？
